title: Beef and spinach keema
summary: Beef and spinach keema is a indian dinner built around lean beef mince 5% fat and baby spinach, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Beef and spinach keema. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add lean beef mince 5% fat and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and baby spinach.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until frozen peas is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Beef and spinach keema before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Beef and spinach keema.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
